name: git
description: Tracks changes in source code and coordinates work between multiple developers. Use subcommands like status, add, commit, push, pull.

flags.meaning: run as if git was started in <path>

name: ls
description: Shows files and directories in the current or given path. Common options control formatting and sorting.

name: cd
description: Changes the current directory. With no argument, goes to the home directory.

name: grep
description: Prints lines matching a pattern. Supports regular expressions and recursive search.

name: find
summary: Search for files in a directory hierarchy
description: Walks a directory tree and filters by name, type, size, and other predicates. Use --help for more details.

name: rm
description: Deletes files. Use -r to remove directories recursively and -f to force without prompting.

name: mv
description: Moves or renames files and directories. Overwrites destination by default.

name: cp
description: Copies files or directories. Use -r for recursive copy of directories.

name: cat
description: Prints file contents to stdout. Also useful for concatenating multiple files.

name: tar
description: Creates, lists, or extracts tar archives. Common modes: create, extract, list.

name: curl
summary: Transfer data from or to a server
description: Downloads or uploads data over HTTP and other protocols. Prints body to stdout by default.

name: ssh
description: Connects to a remote machine and runs commands or opens an interactive shell. Use --help for more details.

name: chmod
description: Changes permissions of files or directories. Use symbolic or octal modes.

name: sudo
summary: Execute a command as another user
description: Runs a command with elevated privileges. Requires authentication.

name: python3
description: Runs Python scripts or starts the interactive interpreter. Use --help for more details.

name: pip
description: Installs and manages Python packages from PyPI or other indexes. Use --help for more details.

name: docker
description: Builds, runs, and manages containers and images. Use --help for more details.

flags.meaning: run a command in a new container

name: kubectl
description: Controls Kubernetes clusters and manages resources. Use --help for more details.

name: systemctl
description: Manages system services and units. Start, stop, restart, enable, disable.

name: ps
description: Displays information about running processes. Use --help for more details.

name: kill
description: Sends a signal to a process by PID. Default signal is TERM.

name: mkdir
description: Creates directories, including parents with -p. Use --help for more details.

name: touch
summary: Change file timestamps or create empty files
description: Updates access/modification times; creates file if missing. Use --help for more details.

name: echo
description: Prints its arguments separated by spaces, followed by a newline. Use --help for more details.

name: sed
description: Filters and transforms text line by line using scripts. Use --help for more details.

name: awk
description: Processes text by records and fields. Powerful for column extraction.

name: head
summary: Output the first part of files
description: Prints the first N lines (default 10) of each file. Use --help for more details.

name: tail
summary: Output the last part of files
description: Prints the last N lines (default 10). Use -f to follow growing files.

name: wc
description: Counts newlines, words, and bytes in files. Use --help for more details.

name: which
description: Prints the path of the executable that would run for the given command name. Use --help for more details.

name: sort
description: Sorts lines in text files. Default order is lexicographic ascending. Use -n for numeric sort.

name: uniq
description: Filters adjacent duplicate lines. Often used after sort. Use -c to count occurrences.

name: cut
description: Extracts selected fields or characters from lines. Use -d to set delimiter.

name: tr
description: Translates or deletes characters from stdin. Useful for case conversion and cleanup.

name: tee
summary: Read stdin and write to stdout and files
description: Copies stdin to stdout and to files. Useful for logging pipelines.

name: xargs
summary: Build and execute command lines from stdin
description: Reads items from stdin and executes a command with them. Handles large argument lists.

name: less
description: Views text one screen at a time. Supports search and follow mode.

name: more
description: Displays file contents one screen at a time. Use --help for more details.

name: diff
description: Shows differences between two files or directories. Use --help for more details.

name: cmp
summary: Compare two files byte by byte
description: Compares files and reports first difference. Use --help for more details.

name: file
description: Identifies file type by contents. Use --help for more details.

name: stat
description: Shows size, permissions, timestamps and more. Use --help for more details.

name: du
description: Summarizes disk usage of files and directories. Use --help for more details.

name: df
description: Shows free and used space on mounted filesystems. Use --help for more details.

name: ln
description: Creates hard or symbolic links. Use --help for more details.

name: basename
description: Prints the last component of a path. Use --help for more details.

name: dirname
description: Prints all but the last component of a path. Use --help for more details.

name: readlink
description: Resolves symlinks to their target. Use --help for more details.

name: realpath
description: Resolves paths including symlinks. Use --help for more details.

name: rsync
description: Copies files locally or remotely with delta transfer. Use --help for more details.

name: scp
description: Copies files between hosts over SSH. Use --help for more details.

name: wget
description: Downloads files from the web. Use --help for more details.

name: zip
description: Creates zip archives. Use --help for more details.

name: unzip
description: Lists or extracts zip archive contents. Use --help for more details.

name: gzip
description: Compresses files using gzip. Use --help for more details.

name: gunzip
description: Decompresses .gz files.

name: bzip2
description: Compresses files using bzip2. Use --help for more details.

name: xz
description: Compresses files using xz. Use --help for more details.

name: sha256sum
description: Computes or checks SHA-256 checksums. Use --help for more details.

name: md5sum
description: Computes or checks MD5 checksums. Use --help for more details.

name: base64
description: Encodes or decodes base64 data. Use --help for more details.

name: od
summary: Dump files in octal or other formats
description: Displays file contents in octal, hex, or characters. Use --help for more details.

name: xxd
description: Creates a hex dump or reverses it. Use --help for more details.

name: hexdump
description: Displays file in hex, decimal, or other formats. Use --help for more details.

name: top
description: Shows running processes and system resource usage. Use --help for more details.

name: htop
description: Interactive process viewer with color and scrolling. Use --help for more details.

name: pgrep
description: Finds processes matching a pattern. Use --help for more details.

name: pkill
description: Sends a signal to processes matching a pattern. Use --help for more details.

name: nice
description: Runs a command with altered niceness. Use --help for more details.

name: nohup
description: Runs a command immune to hangups, with output redirected. Use --help for more details.

name: time
description: Measures elapsed, user, and system time. Use --help for more details.

name: timeout
description: Runs a command with a time limit, killing if exceeded. Use --help for more details.

name: watch
description: Runs a command repeatedly and shows output. Use --help for more details.

name: ping
description: Tests network connectivity to a host. Use --help for more details.

name: ss
description: Displays socket and connection information. Use --help for more details.

name: ip
description: Manages IP addresses, routes, and links. Use --help for more details.

name: ifconfig
description: Displays or configures network interfaces. Use --help for more details.

name: nc
description: Reads and writes data across network connections. Use --help for more details.

name: dig
description: Queries DNS name servers. Use --help for more details.

name: nslookup
description: Queries DNS for a name or IP. Use --help for more details.

name: host
description: Performs DNS lookups for a name. Use --help for more details.

name: uname
description: Prints kernel and system information. Use --help for more details.

name: hostname
description: Prints or sets the system hostname. Use --help for more details.

name: whoami
description: Prints the effective user name. Use --help for more details.

name: id
description: Prints real and effective IDs. Use --help for more details.

name: who
description: Shows who is logged in. Use --help for more details.

name: uptime
description: Shows how long system has been running. Use --help for more details.

name: date
summary: Print or set date and time
description: Prints or sets the system date/time. Use --help for more details.

name: free
description: Shows free and used memory. Use --help for more details.

name: journalctl
description: Views and filters systemd journal logs. Use --help for more details.

name: dmesg
description: Displays kernel messages. Use --help for more details.

name: lsblk
description: Lists information about block devices. Use --help for more details.

name: mount
description: Mounts or displays mounted filesystems. Use --help for more details.

name: apt
description: Manages packages on Debian/Ubuntu systems. Use --help for more details.

name: apt-get
description: Lower-level package management for Debian/Ubuntu. Use --help for more details.

name: yum
description: Manages packages on RHEL/CentOS. Use --help for more details.

name: dnf
description: Manages packages on Fedora/RHEL 8+. Use --help for more details.

name: pacman
description: Manages packages on Arch Linux. Use --help for more details.

name: node
description: Runs JavaScript code outside the browser. Use --help for more details.

name: npm
description: Manages Node.js packages and scripts.

name: npx
description: Runs npm package binaries without global install. Use --help for more details.

name: yarn
description: Installs and manages JS dependencies. Use --help for more details.

name: pnpm
description: Manages JS packages with content-addressable store. Use --help for more details.

name: make
description: Builds targets from a Makefile. Use --help for more details.

name: cmake
description: Configures and builds projects. Use --help for more details.

name: gcc
description: Compiles C programs. Use --help for more details.

name: go
description: Builds and runs Go programs. Use --help for more details.

name: cargo
description: Builds and manages Rust projects. Use --help for more details.

name: java
description: Runs Java applications. Use --help for more details.

name: javac
description: Compiles Java source files. Use --help for more details.

name: psql
description: Connects to PostgreSQL databases. Use --help for more details.

name: redis-cli
description: Interacts with Redis servers. Use --help for more details.

name: sqlite3
description: Interacts with SQLite databases. Use --help for more details.

name: tmux
description: Manages multiple terminal sessions. Use --help for more details.

name: jq
description: Filters and transforms JSON on the command line. Use --help for more details.

name: tree
description: Displays directory contents as a tree. Use --help for more details.

name: man
description: Shows manual pages for commands. Use --help for more details.

name: clear
description: Clears the terminal display. Use --help for more details.

name: history
description: Displays or manages shell history. Use --help for more details.

name: env
description: Prints environment or runs command with env. Use --help for more details.

name: export
description: Marks variables for export to child processes. Use --help for more details.

name: alias
description: Creates shell command aliases. Use --help for more details.

name: source
description: Reads and executes commands from a file. Use --help for more details.

name: crontab
description: Edits or lists cron jobs. Use --help for more details.
